description: This source file demonstrates usage of a Vector class, including creation, arithmetic operations, mutability, dot product, distance calculation, and swizzling features.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical vector with support for various operations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, dot product, distance, and swizzling.

methods.name: mult
methods.description: Mutably multiplies the vector either by another vector or a scalar.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Mutably adds another vector or scalar to this vector.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Mutably subtracts another vector or scalar from this vector.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Mutably divides this vector by another vector or scalar.

methods.name: dot
methods.description: Calculates the dot product between this vector and another vector or scalar.

methods.name: dist
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between this vector and another vector.
